llm_response.reason: The website swahbitcoln.co/bitcoin-linen/ exhibits multiple characteristics of cryptocurrency scams: (1) It uses a fraudulent domain mimicking a legitimate crypto company (Swan Bitcoin) with a typo in the domain name. (2) The website contains urgency tactics, psychological triggers, and promises of expert help for large transfers. (3) It provides ambiguous and likely fake contact information. (4) The domain is registered very recently (2025-07-30) and is privacy masked. (5) The content is full of keywords associated with well-known crypto products and pays lip service to real services to appear credible. (6) Misspellings (Etherium for Ethereum) and references to products or partnerships that do not exist add to credibility issues. All these are textbook hallmarks of a crypto scam website.
